title: feat(types)!: object-grid operations and the grid / kanban / calendar filter follow the @objectstack/spec 17.7.0 rows (objectui#6152, round 8)
body:
Part of #6152 (round 8)

Clause-②: no

Round 8 of this card: the `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 member moves on `object-grid`, `object-kanban` and `object-calendar`, as triage booked them in comment `6029312212`. Round 9 (`ObjectCalendarSchema.calendar`'s `.passthrough()`) is not in this PR; #6152 remains open for it. Claim: comment `6058878246` (branch `claude/issue-6152-r8-17-7-member-moves`, cut from `main` `70e3d772`).

This round narrows and widens nothing, hence `Clause-②: no`. The contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` that the claim names is owed before the queue.

## What changed

**`@object-ui/types`**

- `ObjectGridSchema.operations` takes the `object-grid` row's strict `{ create?, update?, delete?, export? }` block by reference: `NonNullable` of `ObjectGridProps['operations']` on the interface, the row's own member `.extend()`-ed on the flat zod mirror (the `ConditionalFormattingRuleSchema` precedent). `read` and `import` are retired on both faces: `?: never` with `@deprecated` on the interface, a `retirementTombstone()` on the mirror. No `object-grid` code reads either, and the row refuses both by name. The `read` refusal also names the view-level spelling, because the mirror is the source of the `object-view` `table` slot: write `navigation: { mode: 'none' }` or `operations: { read: false }` on the `object-view` node.
- `filter` on `ObjectGridSchema`, `ObjectKanbanSchema` and `ObjectCalendarSchema` takes its row's own member by reference, the `ViewFilterRule` array, on the interface (`ObjectGridProps['filter']`, `ObjectKanbanProps['filter']`, `ObjectCalendarProps['filter']`) and on the mirror (`stripImportedDefaults(...).shape.filter`). These were `any[]` and `z.array(z.any())`, so the AST tuple array and the MongoDB-style record the rows refuse type-checked and parsed. The kanban and calendar flat mirrors are the authored arms, so their doors narrow. The grid's authored door already was the row (objectui#11276); its flat mirror narrows the `object-view` `table` slot.
- The `operators` tombstone's guidance named `{ create, read, update, delete }` as the shape to write; it now names the four toggles.
- `conditionalFormatting` needed no stroke here. objectui#11533 (grid) and objectui#11522 (kanban) had already moved both rules onto the list view's `{ condition, style }`.

**`@object-ui/plugin-view`**: `ObjectView` composed its grid node's `operations` whole (`{ ...operations, create: false }`). With no `operations` authored, that is the view's default, `read: true` included, so every such grid node carried a member its row refuses. The view keeps `read` (its row-click gate in `handleRowClick`) and hands the grid the other toggles.

**Registrations** (`plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-calendar`): the `filter` inputs describe the `ViewFilterRule` array instead of "JSON-rules form", and the grid's `operations` input names the four toggles instead of "create/read/update/delete/export/import".

**Root `README.md`**: the Data Grid example drops `"read": true` from `operations`. Its `properties` now parse on the installed `object-grid` row. Restoring `read` gives `unrecognized_keys` at `operations`, the lit control.

**Console parity `pins` sentences**: `object-calendar.filter`, `object-kanban.filter`, `object-kanban.conditionalFormatting` and `object-grid.conditionalFormatting` stop saying the row is `z.unknown()` or "constrains nothing inside a member". The kanban wire pin's header says the same.

**Fixture triage** over the rule's consumer radius:
- re-spelled to the rule array, because each wrote the tuple array as the authored or documented value:
  - `kanban-calendar-filter-sort-8174.test.ts` (it also gains tuple and record refusal rows);
  - `object-kanban-allow-collapse-retired-8801.test.ts`;
  - `ObjectGrid.filterContextTokens-10607.test.tsx`;
  - `ObjectGrid.recordIdFilterToken-7297.test.tsx`. The wire assertions there follow `toFilterNode`'s lowering, so the operator arrives as `equals`.
- updated census rows in `object-gallery-filter-9309.test.ts`.
- left as written: the untyped renderer and gate tests that feed the AST form at runtime (`ElementDataSourceGate`, the element data-source tests, export and grouping). They pin what a host composes, which the renderers still lower. The objectui#10199 split is written out on each interface member.
- `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` registers the two new spec crossings, `ObjectKanbanPropsSchema` and `ObjectCalendarPropsSchema`.

New pins: `packages/types/src/__tests__/grid-kanban-calendar-members-round8-6152.test.ts` (56 tests) and `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.gridOperationsWithoutRead-6152.test.tsx` (3 tests).

## Measured before editing (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

- **H1, the sites:**
  - Held for the README, the interface and mirror `operations`, `ObjectView` and the console pins sentences.
  - Partly falsified for `conditionalFormatting`. Both twins were already the list view's rule (objectui#11533, objectui#11522), and `gridRowDecorationMembers-8071.test.tsx` already pins its native rows as stored-rule compatibility reads.
  - The interface's second `operations` and the mirror's other two (`ObjectViewSchema`, objectui's `ListViewSchema`) belong to other blocks, measured below, and are untouched.
- **H2, the install surface** (resolved `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`, probed with lit controls):
  - `ComponentPropsMap['object-grid']` takes `{ create, update, delete, export }` and refuses `read` / `import` with guidance. An unknown toggle is refused too (the strictness control).
  - `conditionalFormatting` takes `[{ condition, style }]` and refuses the native members and an extra `label`.
  - `filter` on all three rows takes `[{ field, operator, value }]` and an empty array, and refuses the tuple array (at `filter.0`), the record and a string. The kanban and calendar rows declare no `operations`.
  - `ComponentPropsMap['object-view']` is undefined, and the spec's `ListViewSchema` / `ObjectListViewSchema` declare no `operations`. So the `object-view`'s own `operations` and objectui's `list-view` `operations` are this package's own members, not the grid row's.
  - The grid / kanban / calendar `filter` rows were already the rule array at the 17.6.0 tag (`git show` of the tagged `component.zod.ts`). The bump PR's table attributes them to 17.7.0. The mirrors were behind either way.
- **H3, the live read:** the read stays, and there is no fork.
  - `operations.read !== false` in `ObjectView` reads `schema.operations || schema.table?.operations || default`. Its first feed is the view's own declared member, which the protocol does not govern (no `object-view` row) and which stays.
  - Only the `table.operations` fallback was fed by the grid's now-retired key. The behaviour stays reachable from the view node, and the slot's refusal names that spelling.
  - The runtime read of a stored `table.operations.read` is unchanged. Corpus census (fence-aware JSON and markdown walk plus a TS literal scan): zero authored `table.operations.read` / `.import`. The only grid-row `read` in the tree was the root README.

## Tests and gates (head `e8dee5a4`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/plugin-grid/ packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/plugin-calendar/ packages/plugin-view/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, under the verify lock: `Test Files 749 passed (749)`, `Tests 13272 passed | 95 skipped (13367)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/`, under the lock: `Test Files 179 passed | 2 skipped (181)`, `Tests 5452 passed | 2 skipped (5454)`.
- The 12 touched test files, run alone with the verbose reporter: `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 667 passed (667)`. Each file was counted non-zero.
- `type-check` (the script echoed in every row): `@object-ui/types`, `core`, `plugin-list`, `sdui-parser`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-tree`, `plugin-view`, `plugin-designer`, `app-shell` and `console`. All are `Done`. That is every package whose source names `ObjectGridSchema`, `ObjectKanbanSchema`, `ObjectCalendarSchema` or `ObjectViewSchema`: the downstream consumers of the narrowed types, read against the rebuilt `@object-ui/types` dist. `plugin-grid` first went red on the two typed fixtures above, which are now re-spelled.
- `pnpm check:doc-snippets` (784 of 784 blocks, 0 failed), `check:doc-examples`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:doc-types`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0. The doc gates ran after a scoped `turbo run build` (35 tasks) of their own `--build-filter`.
- ESLint on the 16 changed TypeScript files: 0 errors (pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings only).

**Ablations** (one-shot, through `ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored to the `HEAD` blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`):
- `ObjectView`'s `...gridOperations` set back to `...operations`. `plugin-view`'s `tsc` against the rebuilt types dist gives TS2322 ("Types of property 'read' are incompatible"), which proves the narrowed declaration is the one consumers read. The new view pin goes 2 red / 1 green, and the green one is its `table.operations` control.
- The kanban mirror's `filter` set back to `z.array(z.any())`. The round-8 pin and the 8174 pin go 8 red / 70 green: identity, the differential rows on the tuple array, the AST node and the unknown operator, and the authored-door rows.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters` is a string-keyed `Record` of `any` on the interface and `z.record` on the mirror. The grid row has declared it as the same rule array as `filter` since 17.6.0. It reaches an author only through `object-view` `table.defaultFilters`, where `ObjectView` composes it with named-view filters. It is not one of this round's three members. No carrier.
- `ObjectGanttSchema` / `ObjectMapSchema` flat `filter` stay `any[]` while their rows take the rule array. Their authored arms are the rows themselves (the `properties` bag), so the flat members reach no authored door. Same family, not booked here. No carrier.
- Other console `pins` sentences still call their spec rows `z.unknown()` or `z.array(z.unknown())` (`object-grid.bulkActionDefs` among them, which 17.7.0 types). They are not this round's members. Carrier: the next PR that touches that file.
- The dispatched union held the verify lock for 15m48s on a shared box, and the lock flags that as possible holder-side starvation.

## Deviations

- The base is `main` `70e3d772`, not the `d92b2a15` read at dispatch. `main` moved by one unrelated commit (objectui#11923) before the worktree was cut.
- The changeset carries the `Clause-②: no` line too.

## Size

18 files, +675 / −131 against `70e3d772`. Not governed: `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 18 paths prints "NOT GOVERNED".
